name: PDFForge Studio v1.3.0 (Native Rust Edition)
notes: PDFForge Studio v1.3.0: Added Acrobat-style 100% offline Tesseract 5.5 OCR (scanned page detection, English + Bangla + OSD auto-rotation, deskew/denoise, invisible Unicode text layer) and major performance overhaul (~52ms dark-frame window open, 55-60 FPS virtualized scrolling across 1,000-page & 100MB+ PDFs, fast BMP native PDFium rendering, persistent disk render/search-index cache, 5-12ms repeat search, and built-in Ctrl+Shift+P Performance Monitor).
